title: manifest.json
description: The manifest of an export package (docs/spec/20-privacy.md section 5.2): schema version, instance, person, request, creation time and the size and SHA-256 of every other file of the archive. It is the last entry of the archive.

schema_version.description: Version of the export format; this directory describes version 1.

subject_user_id.description: ID of the person whose data the package holds.

files.description: Every other file of the archive, in archive order.

sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the bytes.
